board.title: Scanner · J · Fixing a misread: One check per screen (round 2)
board.name: One check per screen
board.idea: One flagged move per screen with a counter, Confirm and next, so a child and a parent can settle a sheet at the table without ever seeing the whole move list.
board.differs: You see one move at a time with a counter (Check 1 of 2) and a Confirm button that moves on; Scan-K keeps the whole move list on screen and lets you tap any cell, flagged or not.

board.title: Scanner · K · Fixing a misread: Fix in place (round 2)
board.name: Fix in place
board.idea: Any cell in the move list opens the candidate panel beside the board, flagged or not, so the flags are a filter over the list rather than a queue to walk.
board.differs: The whole move list stays on screen and any move can be changed, even one the reader was sure of; Scan-J shows only the flagged moves, one per screen with a counter.

drawn.title: Scanner · K · Fixing a misread: Fix in place (round 2)

Qb3), six states (empty, updating, failure, no candidate fits, many flags, skipped), plus offline, a guardian's view and the daily limit. Frame C is the phone, where the panel opens as a bottom sheet.

Photo retention: the board shows the photo kept for 30 days, so the crop still shows that evening. A guardian's OK once per child or once per game. Whether the daily limit resets at midnight UTC or midnight Central.

board.title: Scanner · L · Save, share and export: Choose then save (round 2)

board.differs: There is a Save to My games button and a who-can-see-it choice before it, and the share link is greyed until Save; Scan-M has no Save button because the game is already saved as a private draft.

review.counts: Width 1440. The page measured 2728px tall once its fixed height was removed, so the declared height stays at 2750 (root height:2750px and $preview 1440 x 2750), under the 2800 limit. Scan-N has no second part, so second_height is 0. The legend has 6 numbered notes, and the board carries 6 matching badges (1 to 6, with 5 used twice), all in place. The grey note has What, Built from, K's feedback applied and Open for K. The title strip has Built from and Replaces. The main list has 4 rows in 2 month groups (September 2026 with 3 games, August 2026 with 1). The chips read All 4, Needs a check 0, Checked 4, Shared 1, On the crosstable 0. The More menu has 6 actions, with Hide from the crosstable greyed and marked "not linked". The guardian frame has 1 row. The states band has 6 frames (Empty, Loading, Failure, Drafts, Offline, Limit reached). The phone inset is 390 x 844. Copy checks found 0 em or en dashes, 0 {{holes}}, 0 iframes and 0 animations. Every "x.5" match was CSS, none in copy. No USCF, no AI references, and no grade, birthdate or child email. The daily count is in words: "17 of 20 scans left today · resets at midnight", and "0 of 20" in the limit frame. Every state colour has its word beside it (Checked, Reading, Draft · 1 to check; won in green, drew and lost in navy). Gold #c8a94a appears only as fills, dots and rules, never as text on a light ground; gold-ink text uses #866a1e. All tags close. Only the phone's chip row runs past its edge (meant as sideways scrolling), its list runs 6px past the screen under the tab bar (meant as scrolling), and the visually hidden search label reports overflow; nothing else overflows.
